market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG is a strong team, but the Champions League is highly competitive with several stronger or equally matched squads like Manchester City, Real Madrid, and Bayern Munich. Historical pre-season betting odds rarely exceed 20% for any single club, and PSG's recent performances do not support a 58.5% win probability. The current market price appears significantly inflated, likely due to fan sentiment or speculation.
evidence_points: No single club has approached 58.5% pre-season win probability in major league or sportsbook markets in recent years.
PSG has never won the Champions League and was eliminated in the quarter- or semi-finals in recent seasons.
Rivals such as Manchester City, Real Madrid, and Bayern Munich have more consistent deep runs and superior squad depth.
sources_consulted: Pre-season betting odds comparisons for top European clubs (2020–2024)
General knowledge of club strength and past performance
